jobs.prompt: Edit two documents. (1) docs/scope/roadmap.md: after the existing R-049 section (inside stage S8) add two new requirement sections in the same style as R-049 (a heading '### R-050 ...' / '### R-051 ...' then 'Acceptance:' with testable bullets that each name a number or a command). R-050 title: 'A rented GPU worker bursts only after the benchmark gates pass.' Acceptance bullets: (a) `swarm burst gpu status` prints three gate lines with measured values and PASS or FAIL: ready tickets greater than free slots across both Macs for 3 or more consecutive days; every flat-rate lane (Cursor, Codex) rate-limited during that period; GPU model first-try pass rate of 90 percent or more on the benchmark replay (bench harness, same ticket set as the Haiku baseline; last measured: GPU 73 percent, Haiku 100 percent); (b) with any gate FAIL, `swarm burst gpu start` exits non-zero with message `gates not met` and rents nothing, and the numbers are shown to the owner before any rental; (c) once rented the worker starts automatically when the queue stays long, shuts down automatically when the queue is empty for 10 minutes, and its cost counts toward the daily limit (stop or notify mode, hard ceiling still stops it); (d) the GPU worker is only given tickets not marked sensitive and never production code, secrets or customer data, verified by a test that a sensitive ticket is refused with `not allowed on rented lane`. R-051 title: 'Cloud CPU runners run tests and end-to-end checks.' Acceptance bullets: (a) a registered cloud CPU runner runs a ticket's own test command and the full e2e suite and writes pass or fail plus duration to the event store; (b) it is the first burst feature built, before any GPU work, because test waiting is the likely larger win: the benchmark scorecard must show ticket ready-to-merged time and idle slot percent before and after, and the runner stays off unless that scorecard improves; (c) same defaults as R-049: burst off by default, no sensitive code, local queue takes the ticket back after 120 seconds without a heartbeat, spend counted in the daily limit. Do not change any other requirement. (2) docs/architecture/swarm-v2.md: in section '6. Cloud burst runners' append a short paragraph 'Gates and order' that says: CPU runners for tests and e2e come first (R-051); a rented GPU worker (R-050) is allowed only after all three gates pass (queue pressure 3 days, flat-rate lanes rate-limited, GPU model 90 percent first-try on the benchmark replay); no rental until the numbers are shown to the owner; auto-start on a long queue, auto-shutdown when empty, counted in the daily limit, never given sensitive or production code. Write no other changes.
